# GMEOW Contacts Module

The GMEOW Contacts Module — classes, properties, and individuals of the GMEOW super-vocabulary.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/contacts>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:slices/contacts`  

**Type:** `owl:Ontology`  

Contact points and channels (email, telephone, postal address), temporally-scoped contact relationships, and the reified interpersonal-relationship relator (the schema.org / vCard / REL superset layer). Identity trust between contacts (keys, certifications, owner-trust) lives in the cross-cutting trust module.

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/contacts>
